arguments.value: 60-year-old woman with a 1-year persistent pruritic Blaschkoid erythematous violaceous scaly eruption on the right trunk and upper extremity beginning 1 month after shingles vaccination, refractory to multiple topical therapies and excimer laser. Biopsies showed features consistent with ILVEN, and she had a rapid, durable response to intralesional triamcinolone with no recurrence except a mild flare that also responded to repeat injection.
